answer.headline: Revenue fell because of a tracking issue affecting Windows operating system users starting Tuesday, December 15, 2020.
explanation: Revenue decreased compared to the previous week, driven by a drop in the session conversion rate while average order value remained stable.
Tracking health detected an anomaly with duplicate purchase events in the Windows operating system starting on Tuesday, December 15, 2020.
This measurement problem distorts purchase metrics and funnel performance for Windows users, creating an artificial drop in observed conversion.
answer.next_step: Investigate recent tracking implementations or tag manager updates on the checkout confirmation page for Windows users.
